description: C2b golden fixture — the BHY haircut t-stat must NOT be inflated by CPCV path duplication. The objective accumulates daily_returns via all_path_returns.extend(path_returns) over _CPCV_N_PATHS paths (autotuner.py:2172); with the CPCV paths collapsed (C2a) those 5 paths are identical, so daily_returns holds 5x the distinct series. compute_crra_eu_tstat = mean(U)/(sd(U)/sqrt(T)) inflates by ~sqrt(5) when T is 5x too large, making the Benjamini-Hochberg-Yekutieli FDR gate too easy to clear -> noise-grade proposals pass. The fix aggregates per-date (mirroring the cscv_date_returns dict) so T == distinct eligible-date count.
citation: Harvey & Liu 2015, DOI 10.3905/jpm.2015.42.1.013; validation/overfitting.md C2b; GATE2-PLAN A3.
provenance: Hand-authored RED scenario inputs (raw-percent guard-alpha series). The inflation ratio (~sqrt(5)) and the FDR-gate flip are DERIVED at runtime from the live compute_crra_eu_tstat / _haircut_select on the single series vs its 5x concatenation. No SUT t-stat or p-value is pinned as a literal; assertions are ratio bounds and gate-decision flips.

constants._note: _CPCV_N_PATHS is read live from autotuner; sqrt_n_paths_approx is for fixture self-consistency only. The Bessel (ddof=1) correction makes the observed ratio slightly above sqrt(5).

fdr_gate_flips_on_path_duplication.description: A weak-but-positive borderline raw-percent series. At the TRUE single-series T the BHY-adjusted p-value exceeds HARVEY_LIU_FDR_Q (rejected, no winner). At 5x duplication (the bug) the inflated t-stat drives p_adj below the gate (passes, winner). This is the live FDR-gate-too-easy consequence.
fdr_gate_flips_on_path_duplication._assertion_kind: gate-decision flip — derived from _haircut_select(single) vs _haircut_select(5x). No p-value literal pinned.

tstat_inflation_ratio.description: The t-stat over a 5x-concatenated series must be ~sqrt(5) times the single-series t-stat (mean unchanged, sd ~unchanged, sqrt(T) -> sqrt(5T)). The ratio is bounded in (1.5, 3.0): comfortably above 1 (the bug is real) and near sqrt(5)~=2.236 (slightly above due to the ddof=1 Bessel correction as T grows).
tstat_inflation_ratio._assertion_kind: ratio bound — derived from compute_crra_eu_tstat on the U-transformed single vs 5x series. No t-stat literal pinned.

daily_returns_length_equals_distinct_dat.description: After the fix, the persisted daily_returns user_attr must have length == the distinct triggered-date count (the same count as cscv_date_returns), NOT _CPCV_N_PATHS x that count. Pre-fix the extend accumulation makes it 5x longer. Driven via the real objective(trial) closure with a 3-date mocked sim.
daily_returns_length_equals_distinct_dat._assertion_kind: invariant — len(daily_returns) == len(cscv_date_returns) == distinct_date_count. Pre-fix len(daily_returns) == n_paths x distinct. No raw count compared against a hardcoded 5x.
